title: Psychiatric Assessment
definition: The psych assessment explores symptoms, safety, history, substances, and strengths through skilled interviewing. Diagnosis guides treatment but never defines the person. Listening is the first intervention.
patient_flow: Patients arrive voluntarily or via emergency holds after medical clearance. Assessment covers safety, symptoms, and history; treatment plans blend medication, therapy groups, and milieu care. Stays focus on stabilization — typically days, not weeks — then discharge to outpatient care with safety plans, appointments, and peer support lined up.
code_demo:
def phq9_score(answers):
    """PHQ-9 depression screener: 9 items scored 0-3."""
    total = sum(answers)
    band = "minimal" if total < 5 else "mild" if total < 10 else "moderate" if total < 15 else "moderately severe" if total < 20 else "severe"
    flag = " - SAFETY CHECK needed" if answers[8] > 0 else ""
    return f"PHQ-9 {total}/27 -> {band}{flag}"
print(phq9_score([2,2,1,2,1,1,2,1,0]))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
